title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
description: A simple yet satisfying Italian-inspired dish with tender chicken and a rich velvety sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the velvety to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken juices.
Add the zanzibari and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss with the velvety sauce.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the chicken and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
